info.title: OpenAsy Campaigns
info.description: Campaigns in one calendar with their budget, goals, approvals, tagged links and spend, and what each brought from Analytics, Messages and CRM. Viewers read everything; editors plan and change campaigns; approvers named on a campaign approve it; admins also delete campaigns that ran.

get.description:
Campaigns by status, those waiting for the caller's approval, the caller's tasks, this month's budget and spend, and spend nobody claims.

Needs the viewer role.

Read-only: the file (CAMPAIGNS_CONFIG) is the only way to change them.

Needs the viewer role.

Each link's address, whether its token is set, and how its last read went.

Needs the viewer role.

get.summary: The utm_campaign the naming rules make

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start day; today when left out.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only campaigns that end on or after this day.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only campaigns that start on or before this day.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the name, utm_campaign or owner.

post.description:
utm_campaign is made by naming.campaign unless utm is given; it must follow the rules and be no other campaign's (409).

Needs the editor role.

get.summary: A campaign with its links, tasks, assets and what happened

patch.description:
A change to its name, dates, brief, message, audience, budget, channels or goals while it is planned sets every approval back to waiting. utm_campaign changes only while it is planned and has no links. An ended or cancelled campaign changes only its brief, message, owner, goals, adNames and messagesIds.

Needs the editor role.

delete.description:
Editors delete planned and cancelled campaigns; one that has run only an admin deletes. Spend from the ad platforms stays, unclaimed.

Needs the editor role.

post.description:
Only a member the campaign names as an approver, for themselves; any role.

Needs the viewer role.

Refused (409) until every approver has approved. With automation.launch in the file, the playbook's webhook is sent campaign_launched.

Needs the editor role.

A live campaign also ends by itself the day after its end day.

Needs the editor role.

get.summary: What a campaign brought and what it cost
get.description:
As last read from Analytics, Messages and CRM: visits, goals, sends and won deals by channel, each deal counted for its first and its last campaign, and ROI by each.

Needs the viewer role.

200.description: The same link was made before.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: me, none or a member's id.

patch.summary: Change or tick off a task

parameters.name: unmatched
parameters.description: true for spend no campaign claims.

delete.description:
Spend read from an ad platform is replaced by the platform's figures at the next read (409).

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Give an ad platform's campaign to a campaign
post.description:
Its name joins the campaign's adNames, so all its days, and those read later, are that campaign's.

Needs the editor role.

A row a day, campaign (utm_campaign, id or name) and channel. The same campaign, channel and day replaces what a CSV gave before. check: true reads every row and changes nothing.

Needs the editor role.

Google Ads and Meta, for the last ads.days days. Each ad campaign's day replaces what was read before; a day no longer reported goes.

Needs the editor role.

get.summary: Campaigns of a period, by campaign and channel
get.description:
The campaigns that ran in the period, each with its whole results, and the deals won in the period that no campaign touched.

Needs the viewer role.

apiToken.description: An API token made under Settings, API tokens.

utm.description: Its utm_campaign, made by the file's naming rules; fixed once it has links or is live.

anyOf.description: Who it is for, in words.

spend.description: Everything spent: entered, imported from CSV and read from the ad platforms.

anyOf.description: The Analytics goal conversions count, by name.

state.description: changes: the approver asked for changes, with a note.

approved.description: Every approver approved, or it names none.

anyOf.description: The caller's own decision, when the campaign names them.

blockers.description: Why it cannot be marked live yet.

adNames.description: Ad platform campaigns, by name or id, whose spend is this campaign's beyond those whose name carries utm.

messagesIds.description: Messages campaigns, by id, whose sends count here beyond those whose slug is utm.

utm.description: Leave out to make it by the naming rules.

owner.description: A member's id or email; the caller when left out on create.

budget.description: The whole budget; the channels' budgets added up when left out on create.

approvers.description: Members by email or id; approvals.approvers of the file when left out on create.

started.description: The playbook's conditions held and a run started.

url.description: The destination with utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign and, when set, utm_content and utm_term.

qr.description: The address of its QR code, SVG or ?format=png.

anyOf.description: Visits Analytics counted with its utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign at the last read; links that differ only in utm_content share them.

source.description: One the channel allows; its first when left out.

csv.description: day, campaign, channel, amount and note; comma or semicolon separated.

value.description: In the deal's currency, without KDV.

counted.description: In the file's currency, so counted in deals and revenue.

via.description: A tagged visit, a click in a message, or the lead's own source in CRM.
A tagged visit, a click in a message, or the lead's own source in CRM.

touches.description: Touches that name one of the campaigns.

frozen.description: Ended more than results.settle days ago: what was read last stays.

partial.description: The campaign is longer than Analytics' 90 days: its visits are of the last 90.

anyOf.description: null for what has no channel: visits without utm_medium, a CRM lead's source.
The Analytics goal conversions count, by name.
Deals and revenue by last touch.
Deals and revenue by first touch.

series.description: Visits a day over the window, from Analytics.

notAttributed.description: Deals won in the period that no campaign touched.
